Mass 0.96 +/- 0.13 solar masses from Gillon et al. 2009, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,700 K and log g 4.4 (u1 0.475, u2 0.250): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
